name: Hallucinogens
summary: Hallucinogens is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Each category is associated with a unique mechanism of action, subjective effects, therapeutic properties, abuse potential, and toxicity risks.

uses.text: Hallucinogens, also known as psychedelics, entheogens, or historically as psychotomimetics, are a broad and diverse class of psychoactive drugs that can induce altered states of consciousness characterized by marked changes in perception, mood, cognition, and self-experience, along with a range of other psychological alterations.

sideEffects.text: No clear connection has been made between serotonergic psychedelics and organic brain damage. Hallucinogen-induced psychotic disorder (HIPD) is a psychotic disorder caused by hallucinogens and has an occurrence rate of 0.6% in randomized controlled trials.

summaryZh: 致幻劑又稱幻覺劑，是藥理學上對迷幻藥物、解離藥物和譫妄藥物的統稱，屬於一類天然或合成的精神活性物質（精神藥物），包括吲哚胺類、甲氧基苯乙胺類、四氫大麻酚類等。能夠引起意識狀態改變，類似急性精神病，並導致嚴重的行為紊亂。
